content: Tag weighting. Let INLINEFORM0 be a set of geographic locations, each characterized by latitude and longitude coordinates. To generate a bag-of-words representation of a given location, we have to weight the relevance of each tag to that location. To this end, we have followed the weighting scheme from BIBREF7 , which combines a Gaussian kernel (to model spatial proximity) with Positive Pointwise Mutual Information (PPMI) BIBREF48 , BIBREF49 .
